name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Email Marketing | HubSpot Builds, Automated Flows, QA & Deliverability

I build onboarding nurtures, drop-off recovery, reminders, and reactivation flows across email and SMS in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, set up deliverability myself, and keep it above 99%. I work in HTML/CSS, validate every list and import before it goes live, and build monitoring that catches broken automation before a customer does.

Build segmented lists and lifecycle stages on behavior and engagement in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, and validate every data import before a send relies on it.
